text:
Alex (Infra): Heads-up: vendor call at 9am with the cloud SLED rep about EDP structure. Need quick alignment on our asks.
Maya (Finance): Agenda: guaranteed GPU floors, regional anchors, true-up cadence, burst pool pricing, invoice metering clarifications.
Alex (Infra): Confirmed. Our priority: predictable baseline for p50 latency workloads + credits for preemptible use. We should quantify: 40k GPU hours/mo baseline for next 12mo and a 20% burst pool.
Jorge (Sales): Sales wants option to scale to extra 10k GPU hours at +10% pricing. Also request a non-binding runway credit for new regions (we'll need to seed usage when we launch EU2).
vendor-rep: We can do floor + burst but it needs committed dollars. Preemptible crediting is possible if you accept a small availability concession — vendor legal typically asks for up to a 5% penalty threshold on availability.
Helen (Legal): Don't accept open-ended penalties tied to their maintenance windows. Counter-proposal: cap penalties to failures >2% per month and exclude scheduled maintenance with >=72h notice.
Maya (Finance): Also push for quarterly true-up, not annual. We need agility as product launches move workload week-to-week.
Alex (Infra): Technical ask: reserved capacity must be region-tagged (us-west2, eu-central1) and mapped to instance families (A100/H100). We need portability between families with a compute-equivalence credit within 20% tolerance.
vendor-rep: Portability across families is complicated, but we could offer a compute-equivalence credit pool to convert committed A100 hours to H100 at an agreed ratio on quarterly true-up.
Sam (Platform): Operational ask: guaranteed pre-warm pool for rollout days (48h spin-up notice). Also require ability to burst into spot for non-prod without counting against our committed floor.
Alex (Infra): I'll drop a short clause draft for redlines. Please review.
Alex (Infra): ```
Proposed draft clause:
Provider will guarantee access to committed GPU capacity equivalent to 40,000 GPU-hours per month, with regional anchors in us-west2 and eu-central1. Provider will maintain availability >= 97% measured across committed capacity. For any monthly availability shortfall exceeding 2%, Provider will issue service credits equal to 2x the prorated committed spend for the shortfall hours. Preemptible/spot usage will be credited at 50% of the committed rate when used to fulfill workload demand. Compute-equivalence conversions (A100<->H100) will be reconciled at the quarterly true-up using an agreed conversion table.
```
Maya (Finance): Add: quarterly true-up and a 'right to pause' clause allowing us to shift up to 30% of committed hours between regions with 30 days notice (to handle product seasonality).
vendor-rep: Noted. Legal says the 2x credit multiplier is high — they may accept 1.25x.
Helen (Legal): Counter: 1.5x is our minimum. Also insist on a 90-day metering reconciliation window for billing disputes and exportable usage reports in CSV/Parquet.
Jorge (Sales): From GTM: Need a pilot uplift for first 3 months where we pay 50% of committed rate to seed usage and prove value. That helps us hit the floor quickly.
Alex (Infra): Good. TL;DR for the call: aim for firm floor, regional anchors, quarterly true-up, compute-equivalence credits, capped penalties, 90-day metering window, and pilot uplift.
Maya (Finance): I'll draft the commercial redline. Everyone drop comments there. @vendor-rep — please get legal scheduled for a follow-up next Wed. :thumbsup:
